capture_source: live capture 2026-08-28; SAP S/4HANA 2023 kernel 793 release 758. Reply to an RFC_PING invoke sent after the gateway handshake but with NO logon frame at all. Sanitised: GW conversation handle overwritten, byte length preserved. No NI length prefix.
evidence: byte-identical replies were produced by three separate attempts - no logon frame, logon with user/password omitted, and logon with user/password empty - while an authenticated logon on the same system succeeded
notes: The body is EBCDIC, not TLV. A reader walking it as TLV finds nothing usable, which is why an unauthenticated attempt used to surface as 'the response is not a readable RFC message'.

Decoded with cp500 the 97-byte body reads 'FREE 1 00024error during logon'. The conversation is refused below the RFC layer, before any function module is considered - so RFC_PING, RFC_SYSTEM_INFO and SAP_RFC_SYSTEM_INFO are equally unreachable on this release; none of them is callable pre-authentication.
Not parsed into fields. One capture is not enough to claim the layout - what 'FREE' and the two numbers denote is unconfirmed - so only the message text is surfaced.
Distinct from _COM_HEAD, the EBCDIC 'RFC000000000' that prefixes a client logon frame in the other direction.
The trailing padding is ASCII 0x20 rather than EBCDIC 0x40, so it must be stripped before decoding or the printable-ratio check rejects the frame.
